direction.name: BECCI
direction.tone: dignified, credible, confident, inclusive, professional, human

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadows (shadow-sm) on light backgrounds. No drop-shadows on dark sections.
visual_enhancers.borders: Thin, crisp 1px borders using secondary navy or slate for structure.
visual_enhancers.corners: Minimal rounding (rounded-sm or rounded-none) for a serious, institutional feel. Do not use fully rounded pill-cards for content.
visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: Use a subtle gradient overlay (bg-black/40 or bg-[#030E1E]/50) over cinematic photography to ensure high text contrast.

grids_layouts.general: Editorial pacing, alternating between full-bleed cinematic dark sections and airy, spacious light sections.
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous vertical rhythm (py-24 to py-32 for main sections). Ample negative space to convey premium credibility.
grids_layouts.bento_boxes: Use for the 5-pillar ecosystem infographic (Knowledge, Finance, Markets, Networks, Govt Schemes) rather than repetitive generic 3-card grids.
grids_layouts.infographics: MUST be implemented via HTML/Tailwind structure, NOT static images. Use nested grids and typography to construct flow-charts or hierarchies.

motion.scrolling: Implement smooth scroll mechanics (Lenis) for premium momentum.
motion.interactions: Subtle, dignified micro-interactions. Slow fade-ins or slight transforms (translate-y-4) on scroll reveal. No bouncy, chaotic or spring animations.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to WCAG AA for text over images/dark backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a PREMIUM, EDITORIAL, INSTITUTIONAL long-form website. STRICTLY adhere to the exact typography mappings and color hexes provided. Construct infographics (like the 5-pillar ecosystem and empowerment chain) using pure HTML/Tailwind CSS—do NOT use placeholder images for them. Ensure deep navy (#030E1E) is used for the hero and institutional anchor sections to ground the design. Do not use condensed display fonts (Bebas Neue) for body text; reserve it only for massive impact headings. Ensure all image overlays maintain text contrast without destroying the photo's cinematic feel.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but avoid excessive glassmorphism as per BECCI's anti-patterns.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Do NOT center align the app container. Respect optical alignment and reading flow.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on the provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
